expect.name: Spiritual End
expect.cite: table rule hide_attacks_that_can_do_nothing (on): Spiritual End ('If you have 13 or more Pokemon that have the Hide 'n' Sneak Ability in your discard pile, choose 2 of your opponent's Pokemon and quadruple the number of damage counters on each of them') does nothing with 4 such Pokemon: a condition the text reads before it does anything is read as the board is now; off it is (APR A-01: an attack needs its Energy)
